intent: Record as reviewed the takedown, restriction, listing, tier and search rules the catalog Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context catalog lists the seven rules as reviewed, each citing its enforcing code and the test that proves it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Opening a Catalog Skill that has been taken down answers 410 and returns nothing of it.
A Skill's detail carries an access restriction only while one is in effect; a blank restriction is none, and an unrecognised reason still restricts with the default note.
A redistribution value the Catalog does not recognise is shown as unknown and not confirmed, never as allowed or blank.
A search document is listable only once its enrichment is finished or it has an embedding a vector search can find.
A listing records a curated version only when the Skill's tier is curated; any other tier writes none.
Browsing, Catalog risk reads and reference reads fail when the catalog Workspace reader is missing; they never fall back to an unscoped listing.
The public search refuses any purpose other than reference with 400.
